ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisite will be enforced. This section will be taught online. Students must have broadband access to the internet to participate. There will be one on-campus organizational meeting at 3:00 p.m. on May 3, 2012 to cover logistics and address any questions. This course will open to Food Science & Human Nutrition and Advertising majors on Monday, April 15, 2013, at approximately 9:00 a.m. and will open to the campus on Monday, April 22, 2013, at approximately 9:00 a.m.
